row.notes: find-or-add of the driver id -> academy map of DriverAcademiesComponent (map header at comp+0x2b0, entries array at comp+0x2c8). rcx = map, rdx = out slot (u64 entry index at +0, u32 status at +8, written at 0x140e095b7/0x140e095ba), r8 = const u16 key (movzx at 0x140e09232). Callers: 0x140d6ee39 in the academies save loader 0x140d6e840 (strings assignedAcademies, academId; slot 3 of the component vtable 0x14568fd90) and 0x140d6f7b7. After the call at 0x140d6ee39 status 0 calls 0x140e097b0 with the map, status 2 and 3 write the u16 key at entries[index*16] and zero the record at +8 (0x140d6ee65, 0x140d6ee95). Has a .pdata entry; its prologue is a shared pattern, so it binds through the call site
